body:
## Bug
On the shipped v0.2.13, an active session's toolbar **identity is blank** — no agent badge, no name, no subtitle, not even the folder fallback — while the status ("Working ◷ …") and action buttons still render. (Reported from live testing.)

## Root cause
`toolbar(_:itemForItemIdentifier:willBeInsertedIntoToolbar:)` built the `.identity` and `.sessionStatus` items by wrapping the **shared** `toolbarBadge` / `toolbarName` / `toolbarSubtitle` views on *every* call. NSToolbar calls the delegate more than once — a `willBeInsertedIntoToolbar == false` pass (customization palette / sizing) in addition to the real `== true` insertion. The later call re-parented those shared subviews into a throwaway stack, orphaning the live item → blank identity. `onChromeChange` kept updating the (now-detached) labels, so nothing showed.

## Fix
Apple's documented pattern for custom-view toolbar items: build the identity view **once** and hand the live/shared views **only** to the inserted item (`flag == true`); return a lightweight placeholder for the palette/sizing pass (`flag == false`). Same treatment for the status item.

## Verification
- Builds clean.
- Identity renders in the no-session state (folder-name fallback) and is no longer subject to the palette/sizing pass stealing its subviews. Full session-level visual repro wasn't run to avoid disturbing live windows on the test machine, but the change directly removes the detachment path.

Needs a v0.2.14 release to reach installed users (the fix is release-relevant, not debug-only).

title: Fix toolbar identity going blank (badge/title/subtitle)
